definitions: The dark shape and outline of someone or something visible against a lighter background, especially in dim light.
A portrait in profile showing the outline of the subject's head and shoulders, typically cut from black paper and mounted on a light background.
The outline or general shape of something.
examples: The silhouette of the mountains against the sunset was breathtaking.
She had a silhouette of her grandmother framed on the wall.
The dress had a flattering silhouette.
